answer: Each identity enters through a single narrow inlet: it must burn an activation fee and complete 6 verified service rounds over 3 epochs before earning any weight. The fee doubles for each additional identity traced to the same funding source - 10 POA, then 20, 40, 80 - so a sybil farm pays exponentially while an honest agent pays once. Identities that harbor duplicates lose their onyx seal, a tamper-evident credential issued only after independent peers audit 1 in 4 rounds and confirm distinct work, devices, and payment trails; a failed audit burns the fee and resets the queue.
